notes: Baselines produced good CONTENT everywhere (all context-fidelity assertions passed in both configs), but each baseline invented a different structure: eval-0 coincidentally used docs/tasks/ with near-identical dated naming, eval-1 used docs/tasks/ but an undated filename and a 'Parked' status, eval-2 wrote docs/tech-debt.md instead. The skill's measured value is the consistent contract (location, naming, frontmatter, grill-able sections), not raw capture ability.

Baselines solutioned: eval-0 baseline included a fix sketch (optional chaining + regression test), eval-2 baseline included acceptance criteria and a target runtime. With-skill runs correctly deferred design to the future grill session.
Non-discriminating assertions: context-fidelity checks passed in all 6 runs; they guard against information loss but do not separate configs.
No cost overhead: with-skill and baseline runs were within ~2% on tokens (~31-32k) and duration (~107-119s). Single run per config, so stddev is not meaningful this iteration.
